bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; printf 'TARGET_PWD='; pwd; printf 'TARGET_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD; printf 'TARGET_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current; printf 'TARGET_DIRTY='; if test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi; printf 'FFMPEG='; if command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo PRESENT; else echo MISSING; fi; printf 'CREATOR_RUNTIME='; if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^deploy-create-videobot'; then echo RUNNING; else echo UNVERIFIED; fi
